source:
@@U00723@@
Just make it something new!

@@U00725@@
We've only recently returned from Spain, that lovely land of wine and song.

@@U00726@@
(Sings.)

@@U00727@@
There once was a king Who had a great flea—

@@U00729@@
Ah! Hear that! A flea! I find a flea’s a fine kind of fellow!

@@U00731@@
(Sings.)

@@U00732@@
There once was a king Who had a great flea, He loved him so tender, Like a son, loved he. He called for his tailor, Who came on the run: “Make jacket and trousers,” He said, “for my son!”

@@U00734@@
Just remind the tailor his head’s on the block if the measurement’s wrong or the trousers wrinkle!

@@U00736@@
(Sings.)

@@U00737@@
Sir Flea in satin and Silk was now dressed, With ribbons flowing And a cross on his breast. At once he was made A Minister of State, And all his flea kinsfolk, Too, grew great.
translation:
@@U00723@@
让它变得新一点吧！

@@U00725@@
我们最近才从西班牙那片充满美酒和歌曲的可爱土地回来。

@@U00726@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00727@@
从前有一位国王，他有一只很大的跳蚤——

@@U00729@@
啊！听听吧！一只跳蚤！我发现跳蚤是个好人！

@@U00731@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00732@@
从前有一个国王，他有一只很大的跳蚤，他如此温柔地爱着他，像一个儿子一样爱着他。他叫来了逃跑的裁缝：“为我的儿子做夹克和裤子！”

@@U00734@@
只要提醒裁缝，如果尺寸错误或裤子皱了，他的头就很不舒服了！

@@U00736@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00737@@
跳蚤先生现在穿着绸缎和丝绸，丝带飘逸，胸前挂着十字架。他立即被任命为国务大臣，他所有的跳蚤亲戚也都变得伟大。
